weapon.d: Inflicts Spd/Def-5 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Spd/Def-5 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.

Unit attacks twice (even if foe initiates combat, unit attacks twice).
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's Specials by an additional 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If foe initiates combat, triggers the following effect when determining weapon triangle: if foe is counted as blue, unit is counted as green (if number of spaces from unit's space to foe's space ≤ 3, this effect triggers in up to 2 combat instances per turn; otherwise, this effect triggers any number of times; does not stack with other similar effects; when this effect triggers, other similar effects granted to unit are considered triggered and vice-versa. Does not affect skill effects that trigger based on attribute, such as "if in combat against a green foe").
If foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that boost values along with weapon-triangle advantage or reduce values along with weapon-triangle disadvantage (Triangle Adept) on unit and foe.
Unit can use the following【Style】:
―――― Weapon Triangle: Green Style ―――――
When determining weapon triangle, counts unit as green (does not affect skill effects that trigger based on attribute, such as "if in combat against a green foe"). This Style can be used only once per turn.
―――――――――――――――――――――――――
【Style】
Change Style using the Style button at the bottom of the screen.
A unit's Style is only active when that unit is taking an action. Style use is disabled when unit is deployed using Pair Up or when unit is equipped with multiple skills that have a Style.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 50% during combat.

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Spd+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.

If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+7 to unit during combat, and also, if unit deals damage to foe using a Special, restores HP = X% of unit's max HP (X = unit's max Special cooldown count value × 20, + 10; max 100). (Triggers even if 0 damage is dealt.)

b.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.
Neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.
